name: Blast Radius
author: Mark Steere (November 2024) / AGP port

labels.4: side 4 (37 cells, the rule sheet's figures)

description: Mark Steere's 2024 war game on an empty hexagonal board. Every stack of checkers radiates a radiation exclusion zone whose radius equals its height, and you may never place inside one - except on top of your own stack at ground zero. You must always form the smallest stack you can, so the board fills with height-1 checkers until nothing is left but to build, and building detonates: forming a stack of height 2 or more blows away every other stack, friendly or enemy, inside its new blast radius. Clear the board of enemy checkers to win.
